meta.name: paper-analysis-assistant
meta.description: 根据arXiv论文网址自动下载PDF并进行多维度分析，包括文本提取、词频分析、语音播报、播客对话生成、交互式网页、PPT、总结图和引用分析

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析论文并生成总结、播客和PPT
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速理解arXiv论文并制作汇报材料
copy.tagline_en: Automatically analyze papers and generate summaries, podcasts, and PPTs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly understand arXiv papers and create presentation materials

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你给的 arXiv 网址或 PDF 论文，自动下载、提取文本，然后做词频统计、语音播报、生成双人播客对话、交互式网页、PPT 和总结图，还能分析引用链接。
howto.when: 当你提供 arXiv 论文网址或 PDF 文件时；如果你只给部分分析需求，它也会按需执行对应步骤。

say.text: 对这个 PDF 只做词频统计和引用分析
say.note: 它跳过下载，直接执行你指定的两个分析。

say.text: 给这篇论文生成播客对话音频
say.note: 它会先写双人对话脚本，再转成 wav 语音。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can download and extract text from an arXiv URL or PDF, then generate word-frequency stats, speech audio, podcast dialogue, an interactive webpage, PPT, summary diagram, and reference analysis.
howto.when_en: When you provide an arXiv paper URL or PDF file; if only partial analysis is requested, it runs the corresponding steps only.

say_en.note: It runs the full pipeline and produces multiple output formats.

say_en.text: Only do word frequency and reference analysis for this PDF
say_en.note: It skips download and executes only the two requested analyses.

say_en.text: Create a podcast audio for this paper
say_en.note: It writes a two-person dialogue script, then converts it to wav.
